parse_uri_string: parse a string into a Uri object using Uri.parse to extract scheme, netloc, and path
maybe_parse_uri_string: safely parse a string into a Uri or return None using Uri.maybe_parse without raising exceptions
create_uri_from_path: create a Uri object from a pathlib Path using Uri.from_path to get a file scheme URI
convert_uri_to_path: convert a file scheme Uri back to a pathlib Path using the to_path method
access_uri_components: access URI components like scheme, netloc, path, params, query, and fragment as properties on a Uri object
